comment: The declared module boundaries: five workflow contexts over a shared dispatch service, the record, the contracts and the platform. Membership is the declaration the seals hash against and the boundary check enforces - a module missing here fails the lint control, so nothing arrives context-less. Direction rules between contexts are future work; the baseline file carries the tolerated cycles.

platform.comment: Stateless or append-only services every layer may reach: the git seam, process and job plumbing, printing, paths, the clock.

contracts.comment: Shared shapes both sides of any seam consume: schemas, generated types, exit codes, model spelling, transport timeouts, verb registry.

dispatch.comment: How a prompt reaches a model on either transport: routing, selection, identity, the seat.

record.comment: The machine-owned record and its readers: rounds, evidence, critique provenance, owed decisions.

workflow-startup.comment: Register, bootstrap, discover: a repository becomes a place a session can run.

workflow-instruction.comment: The instruction/execution loop: the driver, its plans, its reviews, its agency.

workflow-testing.comment: The testing/fixing loop: evidence, selection of what a change owes, the fix loop, the authored-tests phase, the controls.

workflow-close.comment: Close-out: gates, state writers, packaging, release.

projection.comment: What a person sees: the fold, the CLI rim, the in-process face the extension calls, the six-step workflow verb.
